name: @watermark/viz
description: The React + WebGL island cluster (Epic #1549, Phase 4 #1554): deck.gl/MapLibre maps, the d3-force EntityGraph, the PDF viewer, the scenario simulators, and their layer/data models (field, flow, flowModel, geoStyle, graph, geo, defenseNexus, relationClasses) + the browser-only auth helper. Owns the heavy dependency cluster (deck.gl ×4, maplibre-gl, react-map-gl, d3-force, pdfjs-dist) so the otherwise zero-framework site never loads it — islands mount client:only from the site. Depends on @watermark/core. react/react-dom are also declared by the site (@astrojs/react renders the islands), so pnpm dedupes them to one instance.
